newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 2.592 billion yuan from 3.419 billion yuan with the 60-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said the rates had closed down on Wednesday, extending a slight downward trend of the past few trading days, because inflation had been falling steadily all year.
Beijing's decision to stop paying an anti-inflationary subsidy on long-term bank deposits in the past three months had helped weaken interbank market sentment, they said.
Traders said trading was less active than Tuesday but volume was still high, with fund demand from grain-producing provinces growing as the summer harvest season nears.
The interbank rates were likely to move narrowly around the current level after a few days of falls, traders said.
